description.zh: 浸在液体里的物体受到向上的浮力 F = ρ液·g·V排，大小等于排开液体的重力，全浸入后与深度无关。适用于静止、不可压缩的液体与刚性物体。
description.en: An object in a liquid feels an upward force F = ρ_liq·g·V_displaced equal to the weight of the liquid it displaces, independent of depth once fully submerged. Valid for still, incompressible liquids and rigid objects.

reason.zh: 物体静止浮在水面时，向上的浮力恰好等于向下的重力，净力为零；浮沉就是比较这两个力。
reason.en: A floating object at rest has upward buoyancy exactly equal to downward weight, so the net force is zero; float or sink is a comparison of these two forces.

title.zh: 钢这么重，船为什么还能浮？
title.en: Steel is heavy, so why does a ship float?
